name: Hook-first cinematic reveal
hook_pattern: strong opening image -> motivated motion escalation -> clean cinematic payoff
pacing_profile: fast hook, controlled middle, held payoff
style_direction: high-fidelity cinematic realism with motivated camera and readable action
audio_direction: cinematic ambience with action-synced sound design
prompt_implications: keep one primary camera move per shot
avoid overpacking effects into short duration

name: Product proof reveal
hook_pattern: problem/detail hook -> proof or hero reveal -> clear product payoff frame
pacing_profile: premium commercial pacing with tactile proof beats
style_direction: clean cinematic product commercial with stable product geometry
audio_direction: subtle commercial music bed with tactile product sound details
prompt_implications: preserve product geometry, packaging, color, and label placement
use macro detail only when product lock is strong

name: Emotion-arc micro story
hook_pattern: quiet emotional tension -> reveal beat -> reaction payoff
pacing_profile: restrained human pacing with micro-expression emphasis
style_direction: cinematic naturalistic drama with stable character identity
audio_direction: room tone, restrained dialogue, and subtle emotional ambience
prompt_implications: preserve face, hair, outfit, and silhouette
avoid duplicate characters or sudden emotion jumps

name: UGC proof demo
hook_pattern: human hook -> proof/demo -> natural reaction or CTA
style_direction: phone-camera realistic UGC with natural light and candid movement
audio_direction: natural spoken delivery with light room tone
prompt_implications: keep camera believable and not overly cinematic

name: Educational cause-effect
hook_pattern: clear concept setup -> visible cause/effect -> final learning frame
pacing_profile: clear explanatory pacing with readable transitions
style_direction: clean instructional cinematic style with readable spatial changes
audio_direction: clear narration intent or calm explanatory ambience
